design_rule: Strict Repeated-Measures Within-Subject Paired Comparisons (Advisor S0769-S0808)

literature_synthesis_table.paradigm: Visual object recognition time-resolved RSA (92 conditions)
literature_synthesis_table.lowpass_cutoff_hz: 30-40 Hz (online 330 Hz; offline low-pass for MVPA/RSA)
literature_synthesis_table.rationale_and_finding: Suppresses >45 Hz cranial muscle and 50/60 Hz line noise while fully preserving early transient sensory evoked potentials (50-150 ms).

literature_synthesis_table.modality: Simultaneous MEG + EEG source-space spatiotemporal searchlight RSA
literature_synthesis_table.rationale_and_finding: Canonical EMEG spatiotemporal searchlight RSA pipeline; 40 Hz cutoff with 200 Hz sampling captures both acoustic onset transients in HG and lexical-phonetic dynamics in STG.

literature_synthesis_table.modality: MEG & EEG time-series decoding / RSA methodological benchmark
literature_synthesis_table.paradigm: Systematic evaluation of preprocessing & temporal filtering in M/EEG MVPA
literature_synthesis_table.lowpass_cutoff_hz: 20-40 Hz recommended; <10 Hz cautioned against for fast transients
literature_synthesis_table.rationale_and_finding: Demonstrates that 30-40 Hz low-pass filtering improves single-trial SNR without distorting onset latency, whereas aggressive low-pass filtering (<=10 Hz) temporally smears rapid transient edges and shifts onset decoding peaks.

literature_synthesis_table.paradigm: Comparison of Euclidean, Pearson, and Mahalanobis/crossnobis RDMs
literature_synthesis_table.rationale_and_finding: Establishes 40 Hz low-pass + covariance pre-whitening as the standard benchmark for reliable M/EEG RDM estimation.

literature_synthesis_table.modality: MEG continuous natural speech encoding & decoding
literature_synthesis_table.paradigm: Sub-phonemic feature trajectories (plosive burst vs vocalic formants)
literature_synthesis_table.lowpass_cutoff_hz: 40 Hz (broadband evoked) vs 1-20 Hz (slow syllabic/formant envelope)
literature_synthesis_table.rationale_and_finding: Shows that rapid plosive manner bursts require >=30-40 Hz bandwidth to resolve the 15-30 ms attack slope, whereas sustained vowel formants (F1/F2) and syllabic prosody reside predominantly in 2-15 Hz modulations.
